name: fe-lang
description: Procedure language for the flight engineer's panel: compiler-backed diagnostics, completion, hover, navigation and formatting for .fe files.

fe.server.path.description: Path to the fe-lsp executable. When empty, it is looked up on PATH.

fe.manifest.description: Path to the aircraft's fe.toml, relative to the workspace. When empty, the nearest fe.toml at or above the workspace root is used. Without one the server reports syntax errors only, because whether a control exists is a question only the aircraft's symbol registry can answer.

fe.inlayHints.enable.description: Show the position a verb moves a control to, an analog control's registered range, and a timeout in milliseconds.

fe.semanticTokens.enable.description: Colour names by what the aircraft's registry says they are, so a control a procedure moves does not look like state it reads.
